title: Northern Thai Noodle Stir Fry
description: A spicy and flavorful stir fry dish inspired by the cuisine of northern Thailand, featuring tofu and crunchy vegetables.

ingredients.name: Tofu
ingredients.notes: Extra-firm tofu, drained and cut into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.name: Crunchy Vegetables
ingredients.notes: Bell peppers, carrots, bean sprouts, chopped

ingredients.name: Northern Thai Sauce
ingredients.notes: Made from a combination of chili peppers, garlic, ginger, and fish sauce (optional)

instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the crunchy vegetables and cook until they start to soften, about 3 minutes.
Add the northern Thai sauce and stir to combine.
Add the quaint noodles and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until they are well coated with the sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the stir-fry to a serving platter and garnish with chopped Thai basil.
